# netactuate_cloud_routing_router_interfaces (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Routing Router Interfaces visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_routing_router_interfaces" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Cloud router ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interfaces` (String) Cloud router configuration interfaces as compact JSON.
